name: Camelot

skills.name: Crushing
skills.description: (Basic Attack) Deals 120% AoE physical DMG to all enemies in a 3 x 2 area in the target direction, knocking the first enemy in each column back by 1 tile. Decreases Skill Multiplier by 15% for each 1 additional enemy hit, to a minimum of 90%; Skill Multiplier is fixed at 120% to targets with 6 stacks of Coercion .
skills.note: A powerful Basic Attack that deals damage in a wide area and Knocks back enemies in the front row. You should generally equip this Basic Attack.

skills.name: King's Fighting Spirit
skills.description: A Reaction that reduces Physical DMG taken and grants SPD Up & Extra Action or Act Again upon being attacked. Although it has a long CD of 5 turns, it allows for many attack opportunities when combined with its Trait's Act Again effect, so prioritize including it in your build.
